description: This file implements a web search provider for Ollama, including functions for searching, configuration resolution, and setup checks, along with provider creation and testing utilities.

methods.name: resolveOllamaWebSearchApiKey
methods.description: Resolves the API key for Ollama web search, checking configuration and environment variables.

methods.name: resolveOllamaWebSearchBaseUrl
methods.description: Determines the base URL for Ollama web search API based on configuration or default.

methods.name: normalizeOllamaWebSearchResult
methods.description: Normalizes a search result object, ensuring URL, title, and content are trimmed strings.

methods.name: runOllamaWebSearch
methods.description: Performs a web search using Ollama's API, handling response validation, normalization, and result formatting.

methods.name: warnOllamaWebSearchPrereqs
methods.description: Checks prerequisites for Ollama web search, prompting user if Ollama is not running or not signed in.

methods.name: createOllamaWebSearchProvider
methods.description: Creates a web search provider plugin object for Ollama, including setup and execution functions.
